urls.title: URLs
urls.description: One to 25 public URLs. Every item must explicitly choose ordinary or rendered fetching.

url.title: URL
url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS URL to fetch.

render.title: Render with AdsCrawl
render.description: Use AdsCrawl browser rendering for this URL.

selector.title: Local CSS selector (optional)
selector.description: Applied locally to the full returned HTML; not sent to AdsCrawl.

adscrawlApiKey.title: AdsCrawl API key
adscrawlApiKey.description: Required only when at least one URL has render=true. Keep this secret.
